scripts.build: npm run build -w @playground/views && npm run build -w @playground/host
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n mcp,host,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @playground/mcp" "npm run dev -w @playground/host" "npm run dev:web -w @playground/host"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n mcp,host "npm run start -w @playground/mcp" "npm run start -w @playground/host"
